description: Deep knowledge repository for the Wealth Delta Tax (WDT) project — a 26-paper series proposing an accrual-basis wealth tax with symmetric loss refunds, a sovereign wealth fund, and companion papers on valuation, corporate architecture, governance, rates, behaviour, and implementation.
